title: WhatsApp
subtitle: The channel your clients already use. Connect your number and let reminders go out on their own.

tabs.botHint: The bot that answers your WhatsApp and books for you

connection.tokenUnreadable: We couldn’t read your WhatsApp connection key (this happens if the security settings changed). Your number needs to be reconnected: your conversations are kept and pending notices go out as soon as you reconnect.
connection.title: Your WhatsApp number
connection.lead: Messages go out under your barbershop's name, from your own number. Clients reply to you.
connection.disconnectConfirm: This removes your Meta credentials. Your conversations are NOT deleted and you can reconnect any time.
connection.unavailable: The Meta connection is not configured on the server yet. Write to us and we'll set it up.

state.NO_PAYMENT_METHOD: Your Meta account needs a payment method
state.ERROR: There's a problem with the connection

help.DISCONNECTED: Connect the number you already use with your clients. You can keep using it on your phone with the WhatsApp Business app.
help.CONNECTED: All set. Reminders go out on their own and replies land here.
help.UNVERIFIED: This is NOT a problem: without verification you can message up to 250 different clients every 24 hours — plenty for a barbershop. Verifying your business with Meta is optional and only matters if you ever need more.
help.NO_PAYMENT_METHOD: Meta charges messages to your own WhatsApp Business account. Add a card there and messages start flowing again.
help.ERROR: Reconnect your WhatsApp to renew the permission.

connection.webhookOff: Meta is not delivering your clients' messages to us yet, so confirmations, conversations and the bot receive nothing. Tap “Reconnect”; if it stays the same, write to us.

quota.title: Messages this period
quota.near: You've used 80% of the messages included this period. Nothing is cut off yet, but it's worth knowing.
quota.exhausted: You've used all the messages included this period. Anything queued goes out when the next one starts; upgrade if you need more now.
quota.cost: Meta charges your account about {price} USD per delivered reminder. Three hundred appointments a month costs under 3 USD.

templates.title: Templates approved by Meta
templates.lead: Outside the 24 hours after your client's last message, WhatsApp only allows an approved template. We register them in your account for you.
templates.includeMarketing: Also include promotional ones (birthdays and "we miss you")
templates.marketingWarn: Promotional templates cost about 4x a reminder and your client can block that kind of message. They never go out on their own.
templates.otherLanguage: Meta has it in another language ({lang}); to send it we need Mexican Spanish (es_MX). Tap “Register the missing ones”.
templates.notUsable: Meta has it like this, and with that status it can’t be sent.
templates.created: {count} registered. Meta reviews them, usually within minutes.

failure.token: Your Meta connection expired. Reconnect your WhatsApp and then create the templates.
failure.permission: Meta didn’t give us permission to create templates in your account. Reconnect and accept all permissions.
failure.rateLimit: Meta asked us to wait: too many attempts in a row. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.deleting: Meta is still deleting an older template with that name. It can take several weeks; let us know and we’ll create it under another name.
failure.authNotAccepted: Meta didn’t accept the access-code template for your account. Meta’s message is below; send us a screenshot and we’ll look into it.
failure.invalid: Meta says the template is missing a field or has an extra one. Send us a screenshot of this notice and we’ll fix it.
failure.network: Meta didn’t respond in time. Try again in a moment.
failure.other: Meta didn’t accept this template. Meta’s message is below.
failure.nameHidden: Meta says a template with that name already exists, but it doesn’t show up in your account: almost always it’s being deleted, and Meta locks the name for several weeks. Let us know and we’ll create it under another name.
failure.notUsable: Meta says it already exists, but in a status or language that can’t be used to send. How Meta has it is shown below.

rejected.ABUSIVE_CONTENT: Meta considers the content against its policies.
rejected.CATEGORY_NOT_AVAILABLE: Meta doesn’t allow this template category on your account.
rejected.INCORRECT_CATEGORY: Meta says the category doesn’t match the message content.
rejected.INVALID_FORMAT: Meta says the template format isn’t valid.
rejected.PROMOTIONAL: Meta considers it promotional rather than a utility message.
rejected.SCAM: Meta flagged it as possible fraud.
rejected.TAG_CONTENT_MISMATCH: Meta says the content doesn’t match the chosen category.
rejected.NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: Meta rejected it without a specific reason.

inbox.title: Conversations
inbox.empty: No conversations yet. As soon as a client writes to you, it shows up here.
inbox.archiveNote: Archiving deletes nothing: if the client writes again, the conversation comes back on its own.
inbox.pickThread: Pick a conversation to read it.
inbox.windowClosed: More than 24 hours have passed since this client's last message. WhatsApp only allows writing first with an approved template.
inbox.windowOpen: You can reply freely for the next 24 hours.
inbox.unknownClient: Number with no client on file
inbox.attachmentExpired: This file is no longer available: WhatsApp deletes them after 30 days.

outbox.title: Waiting to go out
outbox.lead: Reminders are scheduled and sent automatically. If you want to hurry them along, here you go.
outbox.cronMissing: Automatic sending is not scheduled on the server yet. In the meantime, this button does the same thing.

campaign.title: Campaigns
campaign.lead: These are promotional messages: they cost about 4x a reminder and your client can block them. That's why they never go out on their own.
campaign.estimated: Estimated cost: {usd} USD ({unit} USD per message)
campaign.promoHint: One line. It's added at the end of the message.
campaign.promoPlaceholder: This month your cut comes with a free beard trim.
campaign.none: Right now there's no one to write to.
campaign.templateMissing: First register the promotional template in the Templates tab and wait for Meta to approve it.
campaign.batch: They go out {max} at a time so we can tell you what happened with each one.

errors.noPermission: You don't have permission to see the barbershop's WhatsApp.
errors.planLocked: Your plan doesn't include the WhatsApp inbox. Reminders are included.

acuse.title: Automatic reply
acuse.lead: When a client answers a reminder with a message nobody handles, we let them know you got it, so they aren’t left waiting.
acuse.switch: Reply automatically when a client answers a reminder
acuse.switchOn: On: the text below is sent.
acuse.textHint: Up to {max} characters. Leave it empty to send the sample text.

rules.onlyUnanswered: It’s only sent if neither you nor the bot answered that message.
rules.oncePerDay: It’s sent once per conversation per day.
rules.quota: It counts as one message of your quota. With no quota left, it isn’t sent.

acuse.readOnly: Only people who can change the settings can edit this.
acuse.storageMissing: This setting can’t be saved yet: a step is still pending on our side. We’re on it.

signup.canceled: You closed the Meta window before finishing: try again and finish with the blue button.
signup.metaError: Meta couldn’t finish the connection. Wait a few minutes and try again.
signup.noNumber: Meta didn’t tell us which number you connected and we couldn’t find it in your account. Try again and pick your number at the end.
signup.manyNumbers: Your WhatsApp Business account has several numbers and Meta didn’t tell us which one you picked. Try again and pick your number at the end.
signup.server: We couldn’t finish connecting with Meta. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, contact support.
signup.network: The connection dropped while we were finishing. Check your internet and try again.
